recent.text: P.J. Washington (illness) is out at Utah for a second straight game. Walter Clayton Jr. is available after being upgraded from questionable. The Jazz remain without Jaren Jackson Jr., Lauri Markkanen and Jusuf Nurkić. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/0FJteFk3pF
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Walter Clayton Jr. averaged 7.3 points as an Iona freshman and was MAAC Player of the Year a season later. Dusty May said Clayton got in great shape under Rick Pitino and that “the chip on the shoulder is real”. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/k4FJRHzw1v
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Dusty May said the other Mavericks are “playing 4-on-4” when Kyrie Irving is on the floor. May tied a lot of the runs Dallas has given up this season to minutes without Irving and called him “a calming presence”. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/U3GX7jY45K
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Kyrie Irving is available at Utah on the second night of a back-to-back. P.J. Washington is doubtful (illness) and Walter Clayton Jr. is questionable (left patellar tendinitis) after scoring 16 off the bench Saturday. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/0FJteFjvA7

recent.text: Dallas, 2-5 away from home this season, plays at Utah Sunday, then NBA Cup games at Denver and Phoenix. Max Christie said the Mavericks are “capable of winning all those games”. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/5NcL0kOm4q
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Walter Clayton Jr. called Kyrie Irving “a great mentor for me”. Irving was one of the reasons he chose Dallas. The two combined for 41 of Dallas’ 110 points. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/vnjS29J8Lk
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Cooper Flagg scored 22 points with 6 rebounds and 8 assists against the Clippers. Dusty May said Dallas needs double-digit rebounds from him on any given night. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/gGxbdOwRoC
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Daniel Gafford had no first-half points, then made all four shots after halftime. He finished with 10 points, 10 rebounds and a game-high plus-22. Dusty May said Dallas could not win without his interior impact. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/Hx4iGOXiKb
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Walter Clayton Jr. scored 16 off the bench and answered Brook Lopez twice in the fourth. The Mavericks play Utah at 6 p.m. CT Sunday. On the return, Clayton said: “Another game, man” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/YtXDT9VAhK
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Max Christie scored 13 points on 5-of-7 shooting, with 3 steals and a block in 24 minutes. He said he made no changes to his shot: “Zero adjustments made” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/iUUG9sRvhy
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Zaccharie Risacher started for P.J. Washington, scoring 11 points with 7 rebounds. He had 6 points and 4 rebounds in the fourth quarter. Max Christie credited his late push. Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/Yuq4rsRKZK
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Kyrie Irving was 4 of 17 through three quarters, then scored 12 in the fourth and played 35 minutes without a turnover. Irving said: “we just had to adjust to whatever they were throwing at us” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/Ufo3vGSlnV
recent.author: Grant Afseth

recent.text: Dallas beat the Clippers 110-100 after an 11-0 run in 69 seconds. Kyrie Irving scored 12 of his 25 points in the fourth. Dusty May: “I thought our defense closed the game for us” Read more on @DALSportsJrnl: https://t.co/OmqA9GY2Rl
recent.author: Grant Afseth
